ai_language_tip: Speak Nepali (ne) politely with 'tapai' or 'hajur'; English works at hotels, trekking agencies, private hospitals and many Kathmandu and Pokhara businesses; Hindi is widely understood.
english_ok: sometimes — Common in tourism, hotels, private hospitals and many city businesses; limited at small local shops, mechanics and outside Kathmandu and Pokhara.
politeness: Respectful: greet with namaste, use 'tapai/hajur' and 'ji'; soften requests with 'kripaya'; thank with dhanyabad.
name_tip: Given name + surname (often a caste/clan name); address with 'ji' after the name or dai/didi informally; book under full name + mobile.
phone_tip: Mobile 10 digits starting 98 or 97 (98X-123 4567 style); Kathmandu landline 01-123 4567; read back in groups.
time_tip: 12-hour with 'bihana/diuso/beluka/raati' (morning/afternoon/evening/night); 'saadhe saat' = 7:30, 'paune aath' = 7:45, 'sawa saat' = 7:15; check whether a date is BS or AD.
number_tip: Devanagari digits (०–९) appear alongside Western digits; the Bikram Sambat calendar (about 56–57 years ahead of AD) is used for official dates; prices in rupees (Rs).
avoid_calling: Avoid lunch 13:00–14:00, calls before 10:00 and after 20:00 to shops, and Dashain and Tihar (the big autumn festivals) when many businesses close for days.
closed_days: Saturday is the traditional weekly holiday; since April 2026 government offices and schools also close Sunday; many private shops open Sunday; Dashain, Tihar and other festivals bring multi-day closures.
booking_channels: Phone calls, Viber and WhatsApp are the main channels; Facebook Messenger for small shops and restaurants; hospital apps or phone for doctors; Foodmandu/Pathao for delivery; Pathao, inDrive and Yango for rides; eSewa/Khalti for payment.
voice_menu: Telcos (Nepal Telecom, Ncell), banks and big hospitals use Nepali/English IVR; small businesses answer directly.
callback_habits: Businesses usually call back or reply on Viber/WhatsApp; hospitals may SMS a token or appointment number; couriers call on delivery.

activity.before_dialing_zh: 健行、滑翔傘、泛舟與山景觀光飛行多經旅行社或 WhatsApp 預約，健行許可證（TIMS、保護區）由業者代辦。

may_come_up.what: Agency arranges trekking permits
Paragliding flight depends on weather that morning

sensitive_asked.what: Asks passport and photos for permits

usually_asked: Trek, flight or rafting and date
Pickup from hotel in Thamel or Lakeside

beauty.before_dialing_zh: 髮廊、美容院多電話或 Viber 預約；節日與婚宴季新娘妝（bridal makeup）要很早訂並付訂金。

may_come_up.what: Bridal package needs an advance and trial
Men's barbers mostly take walk-ins

sensitive_asked.what: Asks full payment to an individual's wallet for a haircut

usually_asked: Service: haircut, facial, threading, mehendi, bridal

change.before_dialing_zh: 改期或取消多電話或 Viber 即可；醫院線上掛號依各院規定，不一定能退費。

may_come_up.what: Online OPD ticket change follows hospital rules
Banquet advance kept if cancelled late

clinic.before_dialing_zh: 大型公立與教學醫院（如 Bir、TU 教學醫院）可在官網或 App 線上掛號並用 eSewa、Khalti 付費；私立醫院有電話與 App 預約，現場常發號碼牌依序看診。

may_come_up.what: Hospital OPD tickets can be bought online with eSewa or Khalti
Specialist sees only a fixed number of patients per day

sensitive_asked.what: Asks citizenship number or hospital registration number

usually_asked: Paid online or at the counter

customer_service.before_dialing_zh: 電信（Nepal Telecom、Ncell）與銀行客服有尼泊爾語／英語語音選單，帳戶事項須本人驗證。

may_come_up.what: Telco says SIM matters need the SIM owner

government_school.before_dialing_zh: 行政手續多需本人到場或用 Nagarik App；學校可電話詢問，週六與週日（2026 年起政府新規）不接。

may_come_up.what: Some services available in the Nagarik App

usually_asked: Applicant or child's age and grade

home_service.before_dialing_zh: 水電與清潔多電話叫；地址常以市、區（ward）、街坊（tole）與地標描述，沒有門牌號也常見。

may_come_up.what: Plumber charges a visit fee
Asks a nearby landmark to find the house

sensitive_asked.what: Asks wallet payment before the visit

usually_asked: City, ward number, tole and landmark

hotel.before_dialing_zh: 飯店多經 Booking.com、Agoda 或電話；健行路線上的山屋（teahouse）多由健行社安排；入住須出示護照或公民證。

may_come_up.what: Passport or citizenship needed at check-in
Teahouse rooms are arranged by the trekking agency

sensitive_asked.what: Asks passport copy by WhatsApp in advance

inquiry.before_dialing_zh: 詢問營業時間、德賽節與燈節是否營業、可否用 eSewa、Khalti 或 Fonepay、罷工（banda）或停電日是否營業。

may_come_up.what: Gives Dashain-Tihar closing days
Says eSewa, Khalti, Fonepay accepted

pet.before_dialing_zh: 獸醫與寵物美容多集中在加德滿都谷地，可電話預約。

may_come_up.what: Grooming by breed size
Vet asks vaccine record

sensitive_asked.what: Boarding prepayment to a personal wallet

property.before_dialing_zh: 租屋多看 Facebook 社團與分類網站，房東與仲介（broker）習慣電話約看房；常以「幾間房（flat/room）」出租。

may_come_up.what: Broker arranges the viewing by phone
Broker fee equal to part of one month's rent

sensitive_asked.what: Asks advance before showing the flat

repair.before_dialing_zh: 機車是主要交通工具，修理行（workshop）多直接到場；原廠保養可電話預約。

may_come_up.what: Authorised service centre books free servicing by phone
Workshop quotes after inspection

usually_asked: Bike or car model and number plate

restaurant.before_dialing_zh: 尼泊爾餐廳多電話或 Viber、Facebook 粉專訂位，一般小店多現場用餐；德賽節、燈節與婚宴季包廂與宴會廳要提早並付訂金。

may_come_up.what: Banquet hall for a wedding or bratabandha needs an advance by eSewa or bank
Small eateries say no booking needed, just walk in
Rooftop seating depends on weather

sensitive_asked.what: Asks advance from the caller's own eSewa or Khalti wallet

usually_asked: Veg or non-veg, no buff or no pork

shop_order.before_dialing_zh: 蛋糕、甜點與節慶禮品常電話或 Viber 預訂並先付 eSewa 訂金；燈節與德賽節前要提早。

may_come_up.what: Cake advance by eSewa or Khalti

sensitive_asked.what: Asks full payment to an unknown wallet

usually_asked: Cake pound size and flavour, eggless or not

takeout.before_dialing_zh: 餐廳可電話點餐打包，外送以 Foodmandu、Pathao Food 為主；常問 momo 種類（雞、水牛、素）。

may_come_up.what: Delivery only through Foodmandu or Pathao Food
Pay by Fonepay QR at pickup

sensitive_asked.what: Asks wallet transfer before cooking a small order

tracking.before_dialing_zh: Nepal Post 與本地快遞多電話詢問；國際包裹建議用追蹤號在官網查。

may_come_up.what: Local courier calls the receiver before delivery

sensitive_asked.what: Asks the receiver's citizenship to release a parcel

transport.before_dialing_zh: 叫車以 Pathao、inDrive 為主，機車載客常見；機場接送與長途包車可電話或 WhatsApp 預約。

may_come_up.what: Suggests Pathao or inDrive in Kathmandu and Pokhara
Jeep or car hire priced per day including driver

sensitive_asked.what: Asks passport copy for a long-distance hire
